action.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-validate/adm
echo "=== with admin session cookie, access /admin/dashboard ==="
curl -sS -m 10 -b a_cookies.txt -o a_dash.html -w 'HTTP:%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8080/admin/dashboard
grep -oE '<title>[^<]*</title>' a_dash.html | head -1
echo "--- check for bootstrap-locked / dashboard content ---"
grep -oiE 'dashboard|instance|server|kai|admin' a_dash.html | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head
